label: Eliminating a nodal matrix row by row
section: Eliminating a nodal matrix row by row
subgoals: Divide each entry below the pivot by the pivot to get the multipliers
Subtract multiplier times the pivot row from each lower row
Store the multipliers in L and the reduced rows in U

label: The Schur complement update
subgoals: Update the trailing block by subtracting multiplier times pivot row
Compute the next multiplier from the updated column
Read the last pivot after the final update

label: Symbolic structure before numeric values
subgoals: Run ordering and symbolic factorization once per pattern
Size L and U as nnz(A) plus twice the fill
Repeat only the numeric refactorization at each Newton iteration
